plugin.name: YouTubeMusic
plugin.title: YouTube Music
plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: Faster track starts: on platforms where yt-dlp installs as a standalone binary (most Linux servers), the plugin now also installs the matching Python package so it can resolve stream links in-process and reuse the already-running Node helper, instead of spawning a fresh yt-dlp process and a fresh Node process for every track. Previously: a background prefetch no longer makes a track you're actually starting wait behind it for its stream link. Previously: fixes My Library and other personal playlists getting capped at around 100 tracks. Also: Artists and Albums are sorted alphabetically (albums by artist, then title), and all followed artists are listed, not just the first 500; fixes the server running out of memory on small machines when two tracks start at once; real section names in New Releases; new icon; "Go to artist" / "Go to album" in every track's menu; tracks no longer stop early when a download is cut off; Podcasts menu hidden. Based on upstream 1.5.1, plus download priority within 2 downloads.
plugin.creator: schmij97, NikolajChristensen
